item.description: Jason Belknap knospee01 Thu, 02/13/2025 - 14:50 Jason Belknap My name is Jason Belknap, and I am a Journalism major from Rochester, NY. My love for sports and passion for commentating is what brought me to WBNY. If you want to hear more of me, I am on The Blitz every week. GO BILLS!
